title: The standard, with more wow and more you
question: This hand keeps the familiar layout you like (soft corners, readable type, one cyan) and adds a real signature motion built from your own world. Pick one.

options.label: One Dither, Many Shapes
options.lineage: standard portfolio layout plus a scroll-driven particle-dither system
options.thesis: Your portrait is made of a few thousand dithered dots, and on scroll the same dots re-form into each section's art: MAGI's search space clustering, Ghost Layer's guard cone, a car silhouette, an N64 controller.
materials: canvas/WebGL dot field on an ordered-dither grid
options.viewport: Left: big name, two-line intro, Download CV + See my work. Right: your photo as a live dot-dither field that tilts with the cursor and scatters when you hover; a small caption says the dots become MAGI next.
options.risk: The most engineering to build (one particle system, several target shapes); calm by default, it must never animate when you are reading.

raised.raise: The next shape is always previewed before it forms, so the motion is legible, not random.
One motion only: a single dot field travels the page, nothing else on the page animates.

options.label: Night Drive
options.lineage: nemaas-style canvas scene, made into a drive out of Pasto
options.thesis: Scrolling drives a dithered car down a road out of Pasto under Galeras; each section is a kilometre marker, and the theme toggle turns night into day.
materials: rounded glass card for the intro
options.viewport: A dithered night road with Galeras on the horizon and your car on it; the intro card with avatar, name and Download CV floats over the left side.
options.risk: The car theme can overshadow the code if the scene is louder than the content; it shrinks to a strip after the hero.

raised.raise: Speed on a diagonal: the road and the scroll share one direction of travel.

options.label: The Cartridge
options.lineage: N64 emulation origin, rendered in 3D with a dither post-process
options.thesis: A 3D cartridge you can turn with the mouse, its label a dithered picture of you; each project below is its own cartridge with dithered label art.
materials: three.js model with a dither shader
options.viewport: Name and the N64 origin line on the left, a large turnable cartridge with your dithered portrait on its label on the right.
options.risk: Leans hardest toward games, which you said should not take over; it is also the most derivative of a real product's shape.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.thesis: The site as a live code buffer.
options.viewport: A code buffer at stage scale.
options.case: Ruled out by your brief: terminal mono type.
options.kept: Show the next change before it happens.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.case: Ruled out by your brief: terminal mono type.
options.kept: Text arrives with a soft bloom, nothing more.

options.label: Pulp Rocket Plate
options.thesis: Projects as rocket plates on a flight path.
options.viewport: A rocket crossing a red sky.
options.case: Fun, but nothing to do with you.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size, raked glass slides.
options.viewport: Raked slides on a lit bed.
options.case: Hard to read at a glance, which you said matters.
options.kept: Exactly one light travels the page.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Rain that falls by cloud colour.
options.case: Pretty, but hides who you are.
options.kept: Particles follow a field you can poke.
